$$ \sum_{i=1}^n \sin^2\theta_i = 2025 $$

$$ \sum_{i=1}^n \sin\theta_i = 0 $$

$$ x(2k - n) = 0 $$

$$ 2k - n = 0 \implies n = 2k $$
This proves that $n$ must be an even integer.

1. $n \ge 2025$
2. $n$ is even.

The smallest integer greater than or equal to 2025 is 2025, which is odd. The next integer, 2026, is even.

Therefore, the smallest integer $n$ satisfying the conditions is $n = 2026$.
